test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All bats are mammals.

No mammal is a fish.

Conclusions:

(I) No bat is a fish.

(II) Some fishes are mammals.
solution:
Statements:

All bats are mammals.

No mammal is a fish.

The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a552e88d9bafc0fb8a84dd709ede4d00ee3816c6dff371ad931b89b85777a00.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No bat is a fish - **True**(because, all bats are mammal and no mammal is fish, it implies that no bat is fish).

(II) Some fishes are mammals - False(because, no mammal is fish, it implies that no fish is mammal).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
